title: Automotive Diagnostics Engineer
summary: Automotive diagnostics engineers find and explain faults in whole vehicles, including electric and hybrid ones, using scan tools, meters and wiring diagrams. They write the step-by-step troubleshooting guides that workshop technicians follow and sit in an aftermarket, service or vehicle engineering team.
dailyDuties: Diagnose faults on test vehicles from symptoms and trouble codes
Read live data with OBD-II and OEM diagnostic testers
Trace wiring faults with multimeters and oscilloscopes
Write guided troubleshooting steps and repair procedures
Record test results and removal and refit steps
Explain field issues to engineering and workshop teams

skills.expectation: Find vehicle faults from symptoms, trouble codes and wiring diagrams
Read trouble codes and live data with OBD-II and OEM testers over UDS
Understand CAN and LIN networks when tracing communication faults
Measure signals with multimeters and oscilloscopes
Write guided troubleshooting steps and repair procedures
Work from symptom to root cause in a structured way
Explain findings to engineering teams and workshop technicians
Diagnose high-voltage battery, motor and charging systems safely
Track test results and fault data
Report and follow field issues to closure
